Always masculine singular according to the mood

questions.explanation_english: According to the gender and number of the object. Upon adding 'ने', the verb does not change according to the subject but changes according to the gender and number of the object. For example, in 'राम ने रोटी खाई', since 'रोटी' is the object, the verb is used in the feminine form.

key_facts: Transitive verbs change form based on the object when 'ने' is used.
The prefix 'ने' indicates the subject in the past tense.
The verb agrees with the object in gender and number.

key_facts: Adverb placement depends on the type of adverb.
